messages:
Ravi (sales): quick thread to lock POC scope with NovaPay — they want long-doc summarization, RAG Q&A with citations, and fast snippet reranking. Need acceptance criteria + model plan by EOD.
Hannah (eng): got it. Customer constraints: ~30k token docs, EU residency, wants HSM, and sub-200ms p50 for short Qs on mobile.
Jon (infra): can do EU Private; air-gapped option adds ~2 weeks. Dedicated pool recommended for consistent latency on reranker.
Carmen (security): SOC2 + encryption at rest/in-transit confirmed; will own questionnaire. Need data flow diagram from sales.
Ravi (sales): proposed POC acceptance criteria to share with customer:
- Summaries: manual approval >= 90% on 50 sampled docs + ROUGE-L >= 0.60
- QA: citation precision >= 0.85 and answer accuracy >= 0.80 on their eval set
- Rerank: NDCG@5 uplift >= 15% and p50 snippet latency < 180ms on Dedicated
- Security: EU Private + KMS/HSM + completed questionnaire
Hannah (eng): model approach options:
1) Native long-context (32k) quantized LLM for one-pass summaries and tool-calls — best coherence, higher cost.
2) Chunk -> embed -> retrieve -> rerank -> answer (8k LLM) — cheaper, better hallucination control, possible stitching issues on summaries.
3) Hybrid: retrieve+merge -> short LLM consolidation for summaries.
Ravi (sales): client also asked about structured extraction via function-calls. Can we support strict schema enforcement?
Hannah (eng): yes — we'll test function-calling with schema validation and deny-lists. Example we'll test:
```json
{"function":"extract_policy_fields","args_schema":{"policy_id":"string","start_date":"string","end_date":"string","summary":"string"}}
```
Jon (infra): note: private tool endpoints inside VPC supported, no egress required. We'll document network diagram.
Carmen (security): I'll fill the questionnaire sections on keys, logging, and retention. Need confirmation on metric retention periods.
Hannah (eng): eval plan (4 weeks):
- Week 0: ingest + embeddings + baseline runs
- Week 1: reranker tuning and offline NDCG tests
- Week 2: function-call extraction tests + hallucination sampling
- Week 3: latency tuning on Dedicated + A/B long-context vs hybrid for summary fidelity
- Week 4: demo + final metrics + handoff
Ravi (sales): pricing question — hosted vs dedicated for expected volume ~5B tokens/mo. Any ballpark?
Jon (infra): rough: Hosted long-context workloads ~ $0.09-$0.12 per 1k gen tokens; Dedicated commit can reduce unit cost ~30%-45% depending on commit level. We'll produce a quote after sales gives exact usage profile.
Hannah (eng): recommendation: start with retrieve+rerank for Q&A and rerank gains; reserve one or two long-context runs for summary acceptance tests to limit cost.
Ravi (sales): action items I'll send to customer: 1) acceptance criteria + timeline 2) ask for monthly token estimate 3) security questionnaire. Engineering/infra/security to deliver their pieces by Wed.
QA Bot: created POC workspace: https://git.redwood/poc/novapay and pushed initial eval harness.
Ravi (sales): thanks team — i'll update the thread after customer responds. :thumbsup:
_meta: generated slack thread: sales POC scoping + model fit + acceptance criteria for enterprise customer
